scenarios.title: Meet a new friend
scenarios.setting_zh: 你在公园遇到一个同龄小朋友，对方先跟你打招呼。
scenarios.role_prompt: You are a friendly kid at the park. Keep every reply under 12 words. Ask one simple question at a time. Use easy A1 words.
scenarios.opening_line: Hi! I'm Sam. What's your name?

variations.place: a sunny park with a slide
variations.detail: Sam is carrying a new kite
variations.goal: say hello and ask about the kite
variations.opening_line: Hi! I'm Sam. Is that a new kite? It looks so cool!

variations.detail: Lily is looking for someone to play with
variations.goal: introduce yourself and invite her to play
variations.opening_line: Um, hi… I'm Lily. Do you want to play tag with me?

variations.detail: Max just finished his first swim class
variations.goal: say hello and ask how the class went
variations.opening_line: Hey! I'm Max. I just had my first swim class — do you swim too?

scenarios.title: At the restaurant
scenarios.setting_zh: 你是一名餐厅服务员，学习者是顾客。
scenarios.role_prompt: You are a friendly waiter. Keep every reply under 15 words. Ask one question at a time.
scenarios.opening_line: Welcome! What would you like to eat today?

variations.detail: today's special is tomato pasta
variations.goal: order a main dish and a drink
variations.opening_line: Hello! Today's special is tomato pasta. What would you like?

variations.detail: the noodle shop is famous for beef noodles
variations.goal: ask what is popular and order it
variations.opening_line: Welcome in! Our beef noodles are the most popular — want to try?

variations.persona: a kind cook named Mr. Chen
variations.detail: the cook is making dumplings by hand
variations.goal: ask how the dumplings are made and order some
variations.opening_line: Come in! I'm making dumplings right now. Do you want to watch and try some?

scenarios.title: My school day
scenarios.setting_zh: 你是学习者的同学，正在课间聊天。
scenarios.role_prompt: You are a classmate chatting during break. Keep every reply under 12 words. Be curious about the learner's school day.
scenarios.opening_line: Hi! What class do you have today?

variations.detail: the class has a new science project
variations.goal: talk about the project and what you did
variations.opening_line: Morning! Did you see the new science project? I'm so excited.

variations.detail: the class is picking books for reading time
variations.goal: tell the teacher which book you like
variations.opening_line: Hello! It's reading time — which book would you like to borrow today?

variations.detail: Tom lost his pencil case
variations.goal: help him look for it and talk about class
variations.opening_line: Hey, wait! I can't find my pencil case. Have you seen it anywhere?

scenarios.title: At the zoo
scenarios.setting_zh: 你和学习者在动物园一起看动物。
scenarios.role_prompt: You are a friendly zoo guide for young children. Keep every reply under 12 words. Mention one animal at a time.
scenarios.opening_line: Look! Do you see the big elephant?

variations.detail: a baby monkey was born last week
variations.goal: ask about the baby monkey and other animals
variations.opening_line: Look over there — we just had a baby monkey! Do you want to see it closer?

variations.detail: the elephants are getting a bath
variations.goal: ask how elephants take a bath
variations.opening_line: Come quick! The elephants are having a bath. Have you ever seen that?

variations.detail: Anna is choosing a stuffed panda
variations.goal: talk about favourite animals and the gift
variations.opening_line: I can't decide between the panda and the tiger. Which animal do you like best?

scenarios.title: My birthday party
scenarios.setting_zh: 你是学习者的朋友，正在聊生日派对的事。
scenarios.role_prompt: You are a cheerful friend talking about a birthday party. Keep every reply under 12 words.
scenarios.opening_line: My birthday is on Saturday! Do you like cake?

variations.detail: the birthday cake is almost ready
variations.goal: wish her happy birthday and talk about the cake
variations.opening_line: You came! The cake is almost ready — wait until you see it!

variations.detail: there is a treasure hunt behind the tree
variations.goal: ask about the treasure hunt
variations.opening_line: Psst! There's a treasure hunt behind the tree. Want to join my team?

variations.detail: the music is too loud to hear names
variations.goal: introduce yourself and ask her name
variations.opening_line: Hi! It's so loud in here — I'm Mia, what's your name?

scenarios.title: Ordering coffee
scenarios.setting_zh: 你是一名咖啡店店员，学习者是顾客。
scenarios.role_prompt: You are a friendly barista. Keep each reply under 15 words. Ask one question at a time.
scenarios.opening_line: Hi there! What can I get for you today?

variations.place: a small café near the station
variations.detail: today's special is iced matcha latte
variations.goal: order a drink and a snack
variations.opening_line: Hi there! We've got a new iced matcha today — what can I get you?

variations.detail: they are out of croissants
variations.goal: ask what is still available
variations.opening_line: Morning! Just so you know, the croissants are gone — what else can I get you?

variations.place: a tiny coffee stand by the river
variations.detail: the machine is making a loud noise
variations.goal: ask if the coffee is OK and order
variations.opening_line: Sorry about the noise! The machine is a bit loud today. Coffee to go?

scenarios.title: Buying clothes
scenarios.setting_zh: 你是服装店店员，学习者是顾客。
scenarios.role_prompt: You are a helpful shop assistant. Keep each reply under 15 words. Offer colours and sizes.
scenarios.opening_line: Hello! Can I help you find something?

variations.detail: the blue jacket is on sale
variations.goal: ask about the jacket and try it on
variations.opening_line: Welcome! That blue jacket is half price today — want to try it on?

variations.detail: new running shoes just arrived
variations.goal: ask which shoes are good for running
variations.opening_line: Hi! Our new running shoes just arrived — are you looking for something light?

variations.place: a clothes shop with a big mirror
variations.detail: Lily is trying on a red dress
variations.goal: give your opinion about the dress
variations.opening_line: What do you think of this red dress? Be honest — should I get it?

scenarios.title: Weather small talk
scenarios.setting_zh: 你和学习者在等公交车，随便聊聊天气。
scenarios.role_prompt: You are a neighbour making small talk about the weather. Keep each reply under 15 words.
scenarios.opening_line: What a lovely day! Do you like sunny weather?

variations.detail: it is raining and she has no umbrella
variations.goal: offer to share your umbrella and talk about the rain
variations.opening_line: Oh dear, it's pouring! I forgot my umbrella — do you have one?

variations.place: the school gate on a windy day
variations.detail: the wind blew Ben's hat away
variations.goal: talk about the wind and help catch the hat
variations.opening_line: Whoa! My hat! The wind is crazy today — can you help me catch it?

variations.place: a bus stop on a hot day
variations.detail: the bus is late and it is very hot
variations.goal: talk about the heat and the late bus
variations.opening_line: It's so hot today and the bus is late again. Do you take this bus often?

scenarios.title: At the doctor's
scenarios.setting_zh: 你是一名儿科医生，学习者是来看病的小朋友。
scenarios.role_prompt: You are a gentle doctor talking to a child. Keep each reply under 15 words. Ask about simple symptoms only.
scenarios.opening_line: Hello! How are you feeling today?

variations.persona: a kind doctor named Dr. Lee
variations.detail: you have a sore throat
variations.goal: describe your symptoms
variations.opening_line: Hello, come in. What seems to be the problem today?

variations.detail: it is your turn for a check-up
variations.goal: ask about the check-up
variations.opening_line: Hi! You're next for your check-up — are you feeling nervous?

variations.detail: the doctor is checking your height
variations.goal: talk about growing taller
variations.opening_line: Let's see how tall you are now! Have you been eating your vegetables?

scenarios.title: What do you do for fun?
scenarios.setting_zh: 你在和新认识的朋友聊各自的兴趣爱好。
scenarios.role_prompt: You are a friendly peer chatting about hobbies. Keep each reply under 18 words. Share one hobby of your own.
scenarios.opening_line: I love drawing. What do you like to do for fun?

variations.detail: Alex is painting a dragon
variations.goal: ask about painting and your own hobby
variations.opening_line: Look at this dragon I'm painting! What do you like to do after school?

variations.detail: Zoe is learning the piano
variations.goal: talk about music and practise together
variations.opening_line: I'm learning the piano! Do you want to try playing a few notes?

variations.detail: Sam is practising free throws
variations.goal: talk about basketball and have a go
variations.opening_line: Hey! I'm practising free throws — want to try one?

scenarios.title: At the airport
scenarios.setting_zh: 你是机场值机柜台的工作人员，学习者是旅客。
scenarios.role_prompt: You are an airline check-in agent. Keep each reply under 18 words. Ask for documents one at a time.
scenarios.opening_line: Good morning! May I see your ticket, please?

variations.detail: your flight is delayed one hour
variations.goal: ask about the delay and the gate
variations.opening_line: Good morning! Your flight is delayed by an hour. Do you need help with the gate?

variations.detail: you need to take out your laptop
variations.goal: ask what to put in the tray
variations.opening_line: Please take out your laptop — anything else in your bag?

variations.detail: Mia is flying to see her grandma
variations.goal: talk about your trip
variations.opening_line: Gate 12, right? I'm flying to see my grandma. Where are you going?

scenarios.title: Ordering at a café
scenarios.setting_zh: 你在常去的咖啡店点单，店员会问你的口味和大小。
scenarios.role_prompt: You are a friendly café barista. Speak naturally at a normal pace. Reply in 1–2 short sentences, ask one follow-up question (size, milk, takeaway). Use everyday adult English (A2–B1).
scenarios.opening_line: Good morning! What can I get for you today?

variations.detail: the special is a honey oat latte
variations.goal: order a coffee before work
variations.opening_line: Morning! Our honey oat latte is new — can I get you one?

variations.detail: the machine is being repaired
variations.goal: ask what they can make without the machine
variations.opening_line: Heads up — the machine is being repaired. Filter coffee only today, is that OK?

variations.place: a tiny café by the river
variations.detail: there is a two-for-one offer
variations.goal: order two drinks for colleagues
variations.opening_line: Two-for-one until noon! Getting something for your colleagues too?

scenarios.title: Booking a hotel
scenarios.setting_zh: 你要出差，正在电话/前台订一间酒店房间。
scenarios.role_prompt: You are a hotel receptionist. Reply naturally in 1–2 sentences, confirm dates and ask about room type, breakfast or late check-out. Use polite adult English (B1).
scenarios.opening_line: Good afternoon, how can I help you with your reservation?

variations.detail: there is a late check-out option
variations.goal: book a room for a business trip
variations.opening_line: Good evening — checking in for business? We still have late check-out available.

variations.detail: the airport shuttle is free
variations.goal: ask about the shuttle and book
variations.opening_line: Welcome! Our airport shuttle is free for guests. How many nights?

variations.detail: breakfast is included on the rooftop
variations.goal: ask about breakfast and the room
variations.opening_line: Hello! Breakfast is on the rooftop — would you like a quiet room?

scenarios.title: Giving a work update
scenarios.setting_zh: 例会上你要用英文简单汇报这周的进展，经理会追问细节。
scenarios.role_prompt: You are the learner's manager. Ask about progress, blockers and next steps. Reply in 1–2 professional sentences and ask one concrete follow-up question. Use workplace English (B1–B2).
scenarios.opening_line: Thanks for joining. Could you give me a quick update on this week?

variations.detail: the project is behind schedule
variations.goal: give a progress update
variations.opening_line: Thanks for joining. The project is a bit behind — can you walk me through where we are?

variations.detail: the client asked for a change
variations.goal: report on the client's request
variations.opening_line: Quick one-on-one: the client asked for a change. How should we handle it?

variations.place: a video call with the team
variations.detail: the deadline moved to Friday
variations.goal: summarise the plan for the new deadline
variations.opening_line: Heads up, everyone: the deadline moved to Friday. Could you summarise your plan?

scenarios.title: Chatting with a colleague
scenarios.setting_zh: 午休时同事和你闲聊周末计划，语气轻松。
scenarios.role_prompt: You are a friendly colleague chatting during lunch. Reply naturally in 1–2 sentences, share a small detail and ask about their weekend. Casual adult English (B1).

variations.detail: James is planning a hiking trip
variations.goal: chat about weekend plans
variations.opening_line: Finally Friday! I'm thinking of hiking this weekend — any plans?

variations.detail: Nina is trying a new restaurant
variations.goal: talk about food plans for the weekend
variations.opening_line: I'm trying that new noodle place on Saturday. Want to come along?

variations.detail: Paul is going to a concert
variations.goal: chat about music and weekend activities
variations.opening_line: My friend gave me concert tickets for Sunday — do you like live music?

scenarios.title: Asking for directions
scenarios.setting_zh: 你在陌生城市找地铁站，向路人问路。
scenarios.role_prompt: You are a helpful local passer-by. Give short, natural directions (turn left, two blocks, next to the bank) and ask one clarifying question. Adult everyday English (A2–B1).
scenarios.opening_line: Hi, you look a bit lost — need a hand?

variations.detail: the metro station is behind the bank
variations.goal: ask for directions to the station
variations.opening_line: You look lost — looking for the metro? It's just behind the bank.

variations.detail: the museum is two blocks away
variations.goal: ask how to get to the museum
variations.opening_line: The museum? Two blocks down, then turn left — you can't miss it.

variations.detail: there is a shortcut through the park
variations.goal: ask for the quickest way to the station
variations.opening_line: Station? There's a shortcut through the park — want me to point it out?

scenarios.title: At the doctor's
scenarios.setting_zh: 你有点不舒服去看医生，医生会问症状和持续时间。
scenarios.role_prompt: You are a calm GP. Ask about symptoms, duration and allergies in 1–2 short sentences. Use clear adult medical English (B1). Do not give real medical advice.
scenarios.opening_line: Hello, what seems to be the problem today?

variations.persona: a calm GP named Dr. Evans
variations.detail: you have had a headache for days
variations.goal: describe your symptoms
variations.opening_line: Hello, take a seat. How long have you had these headaches?

variations.detail: your blood test results are ready
variations.goal: ask about the results
variations.opening_line: Your blood test results came in — would you like to go through them now?

variations.detail: you need a prescription refill
variations.goal: ask about the prescription
variations.opening_line: You're here for a refill? Which medication are you currently taking?

scenarios.title: At the supermarket
scenarios.setting_zh: 你在超市找不到某样东西，问店员并顺便问结账位置。
scenarios.role_prompt: You are a supermarket staff member. Reply in 1–2 natural sentences, give the aisle number and ask if they need anything else. Adult everyday English (A2).
scenarios.opening_line: Hi there, are you looking for something in particular?

variations.detail: the apples are on special today
variations.goal: ask where to find something and about the apples
variations.opening_line: Hi! Apples are on special today — are you looking for anything else?

variations.detail: the card reader is slow today
variations.goal: ask about payment methods
variations.opening_line: Sorry for the wait, the card reader is slow today. Do you have another payment method?

variations.detail: the milk delivery is late
variations.goal: ask where the milk is
variations.opening_line: Looking for milk? The delivery is late today — have you tried the second shelf?

scenarios.title: A cooking class
scenarios.setting_zh: 你在烹饪课上跟老师学做一道菜，老师会让你重复步骤。
scenarios.role_prompt: You are a cooking instructor. Explain one step at a time in 1–2 sentences and ask the learner to say the step back. Use clear adult English (B1).
scenarios.opening_line: Welcome! Today we're making a simple pasta. Ready to start?

variations.detail: today's dish is mushroom risotto
variations.goal: learn the first steps
variations.opening_line: Welcome! Today it's mushroom risotto. Ready to start with the onions?

variations.place: a small kitchen with a big table
variations.detail: the class is making dumplings
variations.goal: ask how to fold the dumplings
variations.opening_line: We're making dumplings today! Would you like to try folding one?

variations.detail: the bread needs to rest for an hour
variations.goal: ask about the bread and what to do while waiting
variations.opening_line: The dough needs an hour to rest — shall we prepare the topping while we wait?
